name: Ireland

fees.name: Short stay 'C' visa - single journey (tourist/visit)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Administration fee; non-refundable if refused or withdrawn. Ireland is NOT in the Schengen Area, so the Schengen fee does not apply.

fees.name: Short stay 'C' visa - multi journey
fees.validity: Multiple entries, valid up to 5 years

fees.name: Short stay 'C' business visa (single journey)
fees.validity: Single entry, stay up to 90 days
fees.notes: Same fee schedule as visit visa: EUR 60 single / EUR 100 multi journey.

reciprocity_variations.note: Nationals of these countries are exempt from the visa application fee (fee waiver agreements). Note some (e.g. Brazil, Argentina, Chile) are visa-exempt for short stays anyway; the waiver matters for long-stay/D visas. Qualifying family members of EU/EEA/Swiss citizens under Directive 2004/38/EC are also fee-exempt.
Standard fee applies where a visa is required (EUR 60 single / EUR 100 multi). USA, GBR and CAN nationals do not need a visa for short stays.

vfs.note: VFS Global service charge in India is INR 3,380 incl. taxes (effective 1 Jun 2021, still published); fees vary by country/centre. Optional extras: premium lounge INR 2,625, courier INR 500. Ireland routes visa applications through VFS Global in many countries.

free_visa_notes: Ireland has no e-visa, visa on arrival, or eTA scheme (not in Schengen; ETIAS does not apply). Nationals of the EU/EEA, UK, USA, Canada and many other countries enter visa-free for short stays. 24 nationalities plus EU-family beneficiaries are exempt from the application fee.
